shared_or_similar_visual_information: Two raised interval traces with circular boundary marks on a number line. Compare the traces attached to the marks at 1 and 4 in the left image with the traces attached to the marks at −3 and 4 in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The left trace covers values below 1 and the right trace covers values above 4, leaving a gap. Right image: The traces select x < −3 and x > 4 on opposite sides, with none of the middle values selected.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image leaves the middle interval uncovered by both traces. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
